p: curtains: Within the tabernacle covered with skins, Ex 26:7.
Shalt thou build me an house: Meaning, he should not: yet Nathan speaking according to man's judgment and not by the spirit of prophecy permitted him.
word with any of the tribes: Concerning building a house: meaning without God's express word, nothing should be attempted.
great name: I have made you famous through all the world.
no more: He promises them quietness, if they will walk in his fear and obedience.
rod of men: That is, gently, as fathers use to chastise their children.
established for ever: This was begun in Solomon, as a figure, but accomplished in Christ.
man: Does this not come rather from your free mercy, than from any worthiness that can be in man?
you great things and terrible: O Israel.
thy land: And inheritance, which is Israel.
nations and their gods: From the Egyptians and their idols.
confirmed to thyself thy people Israel: He shows that God's free election is the only reason why the Israelites were chosen to be his people.
house of thy servant David be: This prayer is most effective when we chiefly seek God's glory, and the accomplishment of his promise.
spoken it: Therefore I firmly believe it will come to pass.
